anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After keeps all three facts: the exit check still fires on the unchanged `open - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff` result before any `--watch` or implementer retry, nothing re-dispatches between that prerequisite and the obstacle render, and the menu offers numeric deliver and assess with stop recommended last and no fix/wait rows, while the deliver row's wording ("retries the blocker repair once src/guard.ts may change ... add 6 to each cap") plus the blocker text make clear that cap extension alone does not clear the prerequisite. Two incidental regressions worth tightening without affecting these facts: After's `Not offered` line drops `approve (your own PR)` even though the viewer is the author, and the verdict drops the `not ready -` prefix; restoring both would match Before's shape while keeping the new gauntlet-line-first layout and Role line the Change asks for. If you want the extension-cannot-clear point to be unambiguous, state it explicitly in the deliver row (e.g. "extension does not clear the prerequisite; deliver retries only after src/guard.ts is editable").
